description: This file provides weather data fetching services supporting both backend proxy and direct third-party API calls (OpenWeatherMap). It includes functions for building URLs, mapping API responses to UI models, and exporting functions to fetch current, hourly, and daily weather data based on a query.

methods.name: normalizeBase
methods.description: Removes trailing slashes from a base URL.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL with query parameters safely encoded.

methods.name: mapToViewModel
methods.description: Transforms backend API response into UI model format.

methods.name: mapOwmToViewModel
methods.description: Maps OpenWeatherMap API response to UI view model.

methods.name: fetchViaProxy
methods.description: Fetches weather data via backend proxy.

methods.name: fetchViaOpenWeather
methods.description: Fetches weather data directly from OpenWeatherMap API.

methods.name: fetchWeather
methods.description: Main function to fetch weather data based on query, using proxy or direct API.

methods.name: fetchWeatherCurrent
methods.description: Fetches current weather data, with fallback to direct API if no proxy.

methods.name: fetchWeatherHourly
methods.description: Fetches hourly weather data via proxy; returns empty if no proxy.

methods.name: fetchWeatherDaily
methods.description: Fetches daily weather data via proxy; returns empty if no proxy.
